title: Questions for an essay draft
description: The assistant notices a weak spot in an argument and invites the author to work it out.

blocks.text: The review confirms that a person sometimes needs help when they are stuck on a text. The narrower idea is to discuss the draft’s argument through questions: what is being claimed, what it rests on and which step has been skipped. Whether that particular mode is needed still has to be tested on someone reworking an essay themselves.

quote.text: I like this app because it gives me great ideas of what to write and helps me study on the things I’m stuck on

blocks.text: Highlight the thesis, the missing step and the unsupported claim. Ask questions and show the criteria for the next revision.
Do not promise a way past detectors or the teacher’s grade. The value is worth judging by how the author explains the argument and reworks it themselves.
